card.title: Helpful Culprit
card.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

mechanism: A redirects an investigation toward safe tasks while treating evidence on their own body as reasons to lead the inquiry.
confusable: Unlike simply denying blame, A must enthusiastically help investigate in ways that conceal personal responsibility.
comparison: D13-a turns glue and a stuck shard into custody tasks; D13-b turns sugared coffee evidence into experiments and blame on the plant.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
